title: Feature-side noise augmentation for the DYN branch

augmentation.mode: recompute 60-D features on noisy copies of the labelled training sequences

hgb_params_source: E08 seed_results dyn_hgb selected_params per seed and budget; no re-tuning
notes: Only the DYN feature branch is touched; MOMENT and TCN are not retrained here.
The clean-trained arm is rescored under this audit's noise draws, so the paired difference is same-draw.
E13b results stay valid as the 'clean model, E13 draws' reference and are not overwritten.
Validation only; the test split is neither read nor scored.
